name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.easily.SpeechVoiceEasilyDialog1Activity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user starts one of the SDK's easy ad-reward tasks. It shows the task prompt, advertiser, and reward before download or app experience begins.
disableEffect: This easy ad task cannot be started, and its associated reward will no longer be available.
